brief.title: Discovery call — Leave & attendance system for plant workforce — 15 Jan 2026
business_goals: We need this to move onto one system.
Whatever we build needs to pull punch-in and punch-out data from those scanners automatically — we are not replacing the hardware.
Workers should be able to apply for leave from a mobile app, and their shift supervisor must approve or reject it within 24 hours.
If the supervisor doesn't respond, it should escalate to the HR desk automatically.
constraints: Payroll is run on the 28th of every month, so leave and attendance data has to be locked and exported by the 25th.
That calculation has to be built in, it's a compliance thing, we can't get that wrong.
The attendance and leave data needs to flow into GreytHR before the payroll run — ideally through an automated export, not a manual file upload every month.
open_questions: Which metric defines success for launch?

requirements.statement: The system shall Ideally supervisors should also be able to see a shift-wise attendance dashboard, so they know who's absent before the shift starts, not after.
requirements.evidence: Ideally supervisors should also be able to see a shift-wise attendance dashboard, so they know who's absent before the shift starts, not after.

requirements.statement: The system shall The attendance and leave data needs to flow into GreytHR before the payroll run — ideally through an automated export, not a manual file upload every month.
requirements.evidence: The attendance and leave data needs to flow into GreytHR before the payroll run — ideally through an automated export, not a manual file upload every month.

requirements.statement: The system shall Anyone who punches out more than 30 minutes after their shift end should have that overtime flagged for manager approval, since we pay overtime at 1.5x.
requirements.evidence: Anyone who punches out more than 30 minutes after their shift end should have that overtime flagged for manager approval, since we pay overtime at 1.5x.

requirements.statement: The system shall at least two years of attendance history retained for labour audits — the last labour inspection asked for two years of records and we scrambled to pull it together from paper files.
requirements.evidence: We need at least two years of attendance history retained for labour audits — the last labour inspection asked for two years of records and we scrambled to pull it together from paper files.
